title: Always night beach??
content: So a lot of times my mall world, I have like the highways in the air, a hotel/airport, and a school, always, always, by the water unless I'm going away from the "main" location. There's an area I've returned to a few times in my dreams, usually a group of us from the main area will go there. It's always nighttime at this beach, and usually people are everywhere, swimming and socializing. There's an island in the distance too with a mountain, but you can't see anything on it, just the shape of it. I'd almost even say the moon isn't in this area but you can see somehow, even without stars. I just wanted to see if anyone else had a similar place?
